The text that was shown before this instruction is:

"Terms of Reference:

A. The Horizon Scandal Inquiry will:

1. Understand and acknowledge what went wrong and key lessons that must be learned.
2. Obtain all available relevant evidence from the Post Office, Fujitsu, BEIS and other relevant organizations.
3. Establish the facts and determine whether there was any wrongdoing by the Post Office, Fujitsu, or any individuals.
4. Identify any systemic issues that may have contributed to the scandal and recommend changes to prevent similar issues from arising in the future.
5. Consider whether any criminal wrongdoing has occurred and make appropriate referrals to the relevant authorities.

B. The Horizon Compensation Advisory Board (HCAB) will:

1. Not be prevented from monitoring individual cases.
2. Produce written reports in respect of each of their meetings.
3. Have increased membership to ensure that it has sufficient capacity.

C. The government will:

1. Within 28 days seek directions under section 10(3) of the Inquiries Act 2005.
